rationale: Gorenjska banka newsroom is a recurring buyer-side stream dating digital/payments go-lives.
Addiko customer-notices stream continuously records channel/product go-lives and enabling providers.
Delavska hranilnica notices document savings-bank-tier payments/vendor choices unavailable in English.
Facebook page gives early teasers but access/ToS for automated collection is unclear; low incremental value over site notices.
Intesa SI digital-banking section plus dated T&C/manual PDFs act as a de-facto platform changelog.
SID banka is both a technology buyer and a funder of sector digitalisation; ongoing news value.
DBS e-banking pages name shared rails and identity providers behind a mid-tier bank's app.
Small savings bank site completes the buyer census and reveals tail-market shared platforms.
LON newsroom worth monitoring as ownership change is a likely platform-migration trigger.
Sparkasse SI newsroom mirrors group platform decisions and consolidation moves in-market.
ZBS association newsroom is a durable collective buyer-side hub including IT-conference outputs.
Wikipedia bank list is a one-time alias/merger crosswalk, not a continuous signal source.
Shareholder-association entity pages are a snowball directory to mine once for small-institution leads.
Siol business desk reliably dates bank digital-channel and Flik launches; free and high-volume.
SRC integrator magazine gives the supplier-side account of Slovenian bank digitalisation projects.
Single dated comparative analysis article — valuable evidence on app dependencies, not a recurring feed.
Delo finance vertical adds corroboration and occasional vendor names; some paywalling possible.
RTV SLO business desk is free, credible corroboration for major banking/payments events.
Regional advertorial portals preserve vendor detail but are low-credibility and noisy; revisit if yield proves out.
e-JN public case pages give live pipeline visibility on banking/payments tenders; legally allowed.
TED is the authoritative EU-wide award notice source naming winners and values for SI contracts.
TED Search API docs enable the sustainable programmatic award dataset; durable technical source.
Statist gives queryable awarded-contract analytics since 2013 for vendor share and market sizing.
Bulk OPSI notice dataset allows clean enumeration and diffing of procurement notices over time.
Award-decision dataset names selected bidders early and joins portal, TED and contract register.
Published-contract register is the deepest ground truth on scope, duration and price of awards.
Live e-JN tender list gives early warning on upcoming banking/payments procurements.
